checkedAlternates.risk: An Apostolic Nuncio holds ambassadorial rank.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An Apostolic Nuncio is uniquely accredited by the Holy See (Vatican) as a papal envoy (group-1), distinct from secular embassy staff (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Consuls work abroad for their foreign ministry.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Consular officers handle visas, citizens, and local trade under the 1963 Consular Convention (group-3), not state-to-state embassy diplomacy (group-4).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
